title: Khufu project scan shows a network of tunnels beneath the Giza pyramid
summary: Filippo Biondi tells of Khufu project scan shows a network of tunnels beneath the Giza pyramid, about 2025-2026 at Egypt (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Rescan of Khufu to see what lies deep below it

plain: Filippo Biondi, a scientist who scans beneath the pyramids with radar, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that his scan of Khufu, the Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt, points to a network of tunnels underneath it. He hopes one day to go down a shaft and reach one of the horizontal tunnels. In a later interview he stresses that the rescan was not meant to repeat his 2020 work but to see what lay deep below Khufu. If true, it would mean a hidden tunnel system runs under the Great Pyramid.
